# Oregon Audits — Secretary of State Audits Division

> Non-authoritative, AI-friendly reference for Performance, financial, IT and hotline audits published by the Oregon Secretary of State Audits Division — the constitutional auditor of Oregon state government — together with their findings, recommendations, and the audited agency's response.
> Full verbatim text of jurisdiction-authored documents is included in-repo;
> third-party materials are summarized with links to official sources.
> Always verify against the authoritative source linked in each document.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents working in this corpus
- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md): freshness, coverage, and drift at a glance

## Contents

- `[Audit reports](reports/)`: one document per numbered report (`YYYY-NN`), 2020–present — findings, recommendations, and the audited agency's response as its own section. `audited_period_start/_end` is the period examined, **not** the report date.
- `[Source manifest](_meta/source-manifest.yml)`: every upstream report enumerated from the Audits Division's SharePoint list, human-approved before ingestion, with numbering gaps (e.g. GAGAS 3.34 withdrawals) recorded rather than skipped.
- `[Agency crosswalk](_meta/agency-crosswalk.yml)`: audited-agency names mapped to canonical platform agency identities — consult before joining findings to `oregon-budget` or `oregon-kpm`; names that do not resolve are listed in `_meta/unresolved-agencies.md`, never guessed.
- `[Authority graph](_meta/graph.json)`: the corpus's outbound links — ORS/OAR provisions an audit found violated or complied with, and the appropriations whose spending was examined. Feeds `graph_neighbors` and `authority_chain`.
